nodes.n: Guy All The Way In The Back

provenance.edgeDefinition: characters who speak in the same scene
provenance.weightSemantics: count of shared scenes, summed across all ten seasons

attribution.title: Friends edge lists
attribution.creator: Michelle Edwards
attribution.citation: M. Edwards, “Friends edge lists,” The University of Adelaide, 2018. DOI: 10.25909/5c05c2ed862ec.
modifications: Merged per-episode scene co-occurrence edge lists into one graph, summing weights across all ten seasons.
Dropped self-loops and generic role labels (waitress, customer, …).
Title-cased display names from the dataset's lowercase identifiers.
Applied a hand-maintained identity table covering 4 characters: display names, nicknames for the guess field, and disambiguators.
Dropped ties weaker than 1 and characters with fewer than 2 ties, then kept the largest connected component (643 nodes and 2395 ties in, 586 and 2338 out).
Added a normalised rank per tie endpoint so thickness reads relative to each character's own ties rather than raw counts.
Computed a force-directed layout for the full graph, used by the reveal animation.
